summary: What the fillers of an action's slots are expected to have or afford, and what must hold before the action.

classes.name: FillerExpectation
classes.meaning: What the filler of a slot is normally expected to have or to afford.

classes.name: Precondition
classes.meaning: What must hold before the action starts.

properties.name: expectsOfSlot
properties.meaning: The slot whose filler the expectation is about.

properties.name: hasExpectedFeature
properties.meaning: Something the filler is expected to have or to afford.

properties.name: preconditionOnSlot
properties.meaning: A slot whose filler the precondition is about.

properties.name: holdsBefore
properties.meaning: A precondition of the action a frame describes.

value_partitions.name: FillerFeature
value_partitions.meaning: Something the filler of a slot can have or afford.

members.name: HasOpening
members.meaning: It has an opening through which things enter or leave it.

members.name: StandsUpright
members.meaning: It stands with its opening facing up.
